title: One wallet / simple transfers
description: Two-transaction passthrough wallet: receives 2,000 USDG (~2026-06-02 15:59 UTC) and forwards it (~2026-06-11 10:24 UTC).
notes: USDG (mint 2u1tszSeqZ3qBWF3uNGPFc8TzMk2tdiwknnRMWGWjGWH) is a Token-2022 mint: the wallet's USDG account only shows up in the Token-2022 getTokenAccountsByOwner call (the classic Token program call returns nothing).
Inbound 5aYfVHGs… (legacy tx) comes from the grant funding wallet fr6yQk… with an spl-memo and creates this wallet's ATA (rent paid by the sender).

Outbound qcF4bqno… is a v0 transaction fee-paid by a relayer (2wjsaCA… signs as fee payer), so this wallet's SOL balance does not change; the 2,000 USDG goes to dLm61L… (the grant recipient used in other scenarios).
USDG passthrough: history exhausted before range.start (oldest signature 2026-06-02T15:59:55.000Z).
